items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: He had Shelton Hemphill, who came to New York with Horace Henderson's band

ctx.x: Is there anything during that period with Chick Webb? Any experiences that might be of interest?

Well, I don't know. Not really. We were playing -- well, I always -- getting back to Chick, he picked the men for this band, like I said, he made the band up from scratch. He didn't -- and I always remember the trumpet players he had. He had Shelton Hemphill, who came to New York with Horace Henderson's band, and of course you know Horace

was -- sometimes he was doing -- working, and sometimes he wasn't. So Chick went to Shelton Hemphill, we used to call him ScaK, ScaK Hemphill, and he got him to play one trumpet. Then he went down to a dancing school, Melody Gardens or something like that, and hired the two trumpet players who were in the dancing school, which were Louis Hunt and Louis Bacon, and he put the three of them together and he had a wonderful trumpet section. Yeah. That's the way he put them together like that, and it worked…

items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Russell Procope was one of the members of Benny's band... Benny used to get all the band there... and he had Procope down there directing the band and playing

ctx.x: In fact it got out in New York one time that Russell Procope was one of the main reasons why Benny Carter took up trumpet. I've never bought thought that, but I'll explain what I just said. You know, Benny Carter had a band in New York in the Arcadian Ballroom, and he had a big Benny there band, and they loved to have him. And that was during the time Fletcher was at Roseland, before Benny joined Fletcher. And Russell Procope was one of the members of Benny's band. And Benny Carter has always been a guy that,…

So Benny used to get all the band there sometimes and go in the Arcade 14 and go between those big pillars that used to be at the Arcadian Ballroom, which is no more now, but and go to sleep and leave he used to get between those big pillars because and he had Procope down there directing the band and playing, and Procope knew did all of Benny's solos, and he could play. He as often as he did played so much so that Benny didn't get sleepy, you see.
